package normalization_adapter

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"reflect"
	"testing"
)

func TestCorpus(t *testing.T) {
	data, err := os.ReadFile("cases.json")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var cases []struct {
		Branch string          `json:"branch"`
		Input  string          `json:"input"`
		Mode   string          `json:"mode"`
		Value  json.RawMessage `json:"value"`
		Errors json.RawMessage `json:"errors"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &cases); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	normalizer, err := New()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for i, c := range cases {
		t.Run(fmt.Sprintf("%03d", i), func(t *testing.T) {
			var actual json.RawMessage
			var err error
			switch c.Mode {
			case "":
				actual, err = normalizer.Normalize(c.Branch, []byte(c.Input))
			case "base64":
				actual, err = normalizer.NormalizeBase64JSON(c.Branch, c.Input)
			default:
				t.Fatalf("unexpected mode in Go corpus: %q", c.Mode)
			}
			expected := c.Value
			if err != nil {
				refused, ok := err.(Refused)
				if !ok {
					t.Fatalf("unlocated error: %v", err)
				}
				actual, _ = json.Marshal(refused)
				expected = c.Errors
			} else if len(c.Errors) != 0 {
				t.Fatalf("expected refusal %s, got %s", c.Errors, actual)
			}
			var a, b any
			if err := json.Unmarshal(actual, &a); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if err := json.Unmarshal(expected, &b); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if !reflect.DeepEqual(a, b) {
				t.Fatalf("input %s: got %s, expected %s", c.Input, actual, expected)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestPositionDefense(t *testing.T) {
	at := "/defensive/position"
	for i, c := range []struct {
		present bool
		arity   uint64
		value   any
		index   uint64
	}{
		{false, 0, []any{"a", "b"}, 0}, {true, 0, []any{"a", "b"}, 0},
		{true, 2, []any{"a"}, 0}, {true, 2, []any{"a", "b", "excess"}, 0},
		{true, 2, map[string]any{}, 0}, {true, 2, []any{"a", "b"}, 2}, {true, 2, []any{"a", "b"}, ^uint64(0)},
	} {
		t.Run(fmt.Sprint(i), func(t *testing.T) {
			if c.present {
				positionArities[at] = c.arity
			} else {
				delete(positionArities, at)
			}
			count := 0
			operand := func(scope, string) (any, error) { count++; return c.value, nil }
			_, err := positionValue(operand, c.index)(scope{}, at)
			expected := Refused{{Pointer: at, Rule: "position_value", Detail: "position encountered a value outside its checked tuple contract"}}
			if !reflect.DeepEqual(err, expected) {
				t.Fatalf("got %#v", err)
			}
			if count != 1 {
				t.Fatalf("operand evaluated %d times", count)
			}
		})
	}
	delete(positionArities, at)
	positionArities[at] = 2
	for _, c := range []struct{ value, expected any }{{[]any{"a", nil}, nil}, {missing, missing}} {
		count := 0
		operand := func(scope, string) (any, error) { count++; return c.value, nil }
		actual, err := positionValue(operand, 1)(scope{}, at)
		if err != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(actual, c.expected) || count != 1 {
			t.Fatalf("nullable/missing operand: %#v, %v, %d", actual, err, count)
		}
	}
	delete(positionArities, at)
}
